name: a landed hit lifts no worry before Chaos Unison
what: the hit's mood step (src/emu/soulmood.c, BN6_MOOD_HIT) raises his mood by nothing where BN5's adds the Cannon's 0x1E: he stays worried at 0x3A, UNITE does not stand on the third screen and no Chaos Unison comes where BN5's unites KnightSoul
